title: Field Deployment Guide: GX-7 Fibre Gateway

headings.text: Field Deployment Guide: GX-7 Fibre Gateway

key_sentences: This guide describes how field technicians install, provision and verify the GX-7 fibre gateway at residential and small business premises.
It covers the physical installation, the provisioning file, the first boot and the acceptance tests that must pass before a job is closed.
Mount the gateway on a wall or shelf at least one metre away from microwave ovens and cordless phone bases.
The gateway downloads its provisioning file from the auto-configuration server during first boot.
Connect the laptop to LAN 1, open a terminal session to the gateway and enter the commands below.
Never commit a provisioning file that reports validation errors, because the gateway may lose its management VLAN and require a site revisit.
All acceptance tests must pass before the job can be closed in the workforce application.
Escalate to the network operations desk if a fault cannot be cleared within 30 minutes on site.

rows: At least 90% of the subscribed rate
Clear audio both ways for 30 seconds
Signal above -67 dBm in every main room
No optical signal or dirty connector
Clean and inspect the connector, then measure the light level
Check that wan.vlan is 101 and reload the file
Run show voice status and call the network desk
Run wifi scan and move to the least used channel
Firmware 4.2.x commands and new acceptance tests

list_items.text: Confirm the work order shows an active GPON port.
Check that the optical light level at the wall box is between -8 dBm and -27 dBm.
Make sure the customer is present to choose the gateway location.
Optical power meter with SC/APC adapter
Laptop with a terminal client and an Ethernet port
Fibre cleaning pen and inspection scope
Clean and inspect the SC/APC connector on the patch lead.
Connect the patch lead to the PON port on the rear panel.
Connect the power adapter and wait until the PWR light is steady green.
Check that the PON light turns steady green within three minutes.
Record the gateway serial number and MAC address on the work order.

code:
# gx7-provision.yaml
device:
  model: GX-7
  firmware: 4.2.3
wan:
  mode: gpon
  vlan: 101
  pppoe: false
lan:
  subnet: 192.168.20.0/24
  dhcp_range: [192.168.20.100, 192.168.20.199]
voice:
  enabled: true
  lines: 1
  sip_server: sip.core.brightline.example

gx7> login field
Password: ********
gx7# config load usb:/gx7-provision.yaml
gx7# config validate
Validation passed: 0 errors, 1 warning
gx7# config commit
Committing configuration... done
gx7# reboot

gx7# show pon optics
  Rx power      : -18.4 dBm
  Tx power      :   2.1 dBm
  Temperature   :  41.0 C
  Status        : IN RANGE
